name: calendar-money
description: 🗓️ A personal finance app that turns your income and expenses into a calendar, so you can plan your life.

paragraphs: 🗓️ A personal finance app that turns your income and expenses into a calendar, so you can plan your life.

Full-stack cash flow management web application built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Featuring an interactive calendar with drag-and-drop transactions, instant search, AI-powered receipt scanning, advanced Chart.js analytics, category-based budgeting, CSV/PDF backup and restore, adaptive responsive layouts, and a customizable UI.
features: Calendar-first financial context — the dashboard opens with a plain-language month summary showing money coming in, money going out, the net for the month, and the next entries on the calendar.
Complete monthly grid — every month renders all of its days, including six-week months, with a clear distinction between the active month, today, selected days, and days outside the month.

Meaningful day cells — each day shows its running total after that day, same-day money in/out activity, category-colored entries, and a visible +N more indicator instead of silently clipping busy days.
Contextual day view — opening a day explains whether entries are recorded or coming up, summarizes money in/out and the running total after the day, then shows the underlying entries.
Add to calendar — transaction creation is framed as telling the calendar what happened or what is coming, with a live preview of the date and month impact before saving.

requirements.text: Safer removal — transactions, recurring series, categories, and accounts require an explicit confirmation before destructive operations.
The navbar adapts when you are logged in (Dashboard + Log out) vs. logged out (Log in + Get started).
If you self-host behind a custom server, add a catch-all that serves index.html.
